items.text: The Good: -Place is super cute. Def true to the pics. It was very nicely remodeled. Very very cute!! -Safe neighborhood. Walking distance to park, High Street area.  -Cheaper than most hotels.  -Super easy check in and check out.  -Felt safe and secure.  The Bad: -Parking is impossible. The street it is located on is more like an alley. There was never any parking close by. The two nights we stayed we had to park blocks away. Was really hard to find parking because surrounding streets are permit only or meter parking. Would be nice if parking space was made avail for guests.  -The place was clean overall but more attn needed to be paid to the details. For instance the air vents were VERY dusty. As soon as you walk in it smelled very musty and instantly irritated my asthma. Place has no window screens so can’t open a window. Also their were a lot of house spiders and cobwebs in corners and along baseboards. Normally wouldn’t care or notice but we travelled with a kid who slept on the floor mattress. We ended up vacuuming along the wall to suck up the webs and spiders out of concern she would get bit.  -Found a live mouse. Again not a super big deal being that it’s a very old (yet ni

O apartamento é lindo, estava tudo super limpo e organizado. A localização e a vista são de tirar o fôlego! Mais linda ainda do que as fotos! Colin foi excelente, nos recebeu com mimos no apartamento, muito atencioso, respondia muito rápido e com muita proatividade. Super recomendo.

We rented Elizabeth's Cape Cod for a baseball weekend because it was big enough to accommodate our group (two adults; 1 teenager) and a reasonable drive to Target Field. To our surprise, we were a short walk to the Blue Line, which took us right to the ballpark. It was, in a word, awesome! The house is super cute and welcoming. We were allowed to open the windows and let the fresh air flow, which was appreciated. The backyard is cozy, with fancy string lights, a firepit, chairs and (though we did not bring it out) a bags setup, so perfect for decompressing. Elizabeth was super friendly, incredibly responsive and an overall great host! The internet went down at the start of our stay and Elizabeth was responsive and fixed it quickly, and then we hopped the train to the game. This was my first AirBnB and I would definitely do it again -- especially at Elizbath's Cape Cod.

Tilly's apartment is cute and in a perfect location. All appliances were modern and the interior was decorated perfectly. With a tram stop at the doorstep, it was only 15mins to the CBD.  We were greeted at the apartment and Tilly was very friendly and helpful.  If we needed anything during our stay, she responded quickly. We felt very at home and we will definitely be staying again.
This apartment is lovely, clean and has good light. Quiet location but very convenient to the arts biennale as well as central Venice. The host is kind and thorough.

Everything is as depicted. The place was very clean and centrally located, yet quiet. The two bedrooms were far apart from each other and had their own en suite bathrooms and felt very private. Lots of natural light. Enrico was super friendly and helpful and had many great recommendations for restaurants, and left us a bottle of wine, water and some biscottis. We were under a five minute walk to Uffizi. All in all, a fantastic option for a stay in Florence. Super clean and a very responsive host.

Simona is a wonderful host! The apartment is in the PERFECT location for exploring Florence but just far enough to be quiet and make you feel like you live in a true Italian neighborhood. The space itself is perfect for a couple or solo traveler and Simona and her daughter are full of recommendations.

Amazing location. Carlo is a great host, available at all times. The place has everything that you need for a short stay (3-4 days). Most of the best sites are at a walking distance. Good value for the money invested.

The location is really good that we walked everywhere. It’s very close to Victoria and Albert Museum. There are restaurants and shops nearby which is very convenient.  The room is reasonable big for London. The beds are comfortable as well.  The hosts are very friendly.

The Berlin Artist apartment is a great place with nice art and great amenities. It is a really comfortable space and is situated quite close to the ubahn/sbahn and tram which makes it really easy to get around. There are cool vintage stores and cafes surrounding the apartment, and Friedrichshain felt like a quiet and safe area in Berlin. Loved our stay there!

I would highly recommend staying at this cosy cottage. We are a family of 4 and a dog, everything was spotless, fresh and very cosy. The garden is fully enclosed. Dee was very friendly & helpful. Great base for travelling around Kerry. It really is only 5 minutes in the car  into the town of Killarney with great bars & restaurants with Irish live music with classic songs. I would recommend visiting Muchross House, the grounds are stunning and the kids were delighted to see a stunning house preserved from the early 1900s. Overall everything was perfect and I would definitely stay here again. Thank you Dee for the hospitality. Sonya & Paul

Our stay was not as expected. Alejandra was slow to reply my query and I had to send a couple of reminders. The lift has not been working for months - if the listing had been transparent about it, we would not have booked it as my husband broke his ankle and had to climb 5 flights of stairs in his crutches. The wifi was also down, so we were given another wifi that was very weak and slow, and was only accessible in the living room. We had to rely on our own data. The portable air con they listed was just a fan. They were nice enough to give us an additional one though. The unit still felt cool but we had to open the windows for ventilation and that let in many huge mosquitoes which greatly affected our sleep. I would like to commend Yessica though, for her responsiveness throughout our stay, she was helpful and friendly!

Ich habe mich in Gerhards Wohnung sehr willkommen und rundum wohl gefühlt: blitzblank sauber, Einrichtung ganz nach meinem Geschmack.  Leider war die Zeit zu kurz, um alle Tipps von Gerhard auszuprobieren. Obwohl die Lage sehr ruhig ist, sind ganz in der Nähe einige gemütliche Kneipen wo man den Tag gerne ausklingen lässt.  Ob mit dem Fahrrad , mit Bus oder U-Bahn, man kommt schnell überall hin, wo man will.  Ich komme wirklich gerne wieder
Fantastic Airbnb, everything I needed and spotless! Marcus is so helpful, the place is really comfortable and brilliantly located. Thanks so much Marcus!

Advertised as a luxury location which I can't really say was luxurious but clean. A great location in walking distance of restaurants and shops at a great price. Lots of room for a large group or family. The bed itself was comfortable but linens and pillows should be upgraded.  There was a strong and pervasive odor of mildew/mold from the bath area downstairs.  Also, it rained the entire time I was there so I spent most of my time upstairs. I called Ferdinand about the mildew/mold odor and he arrived a couple of hours later.  He cleaned the shower area (which had visible mold/mildew) for over an hour and opened the window to air the bathroom.  This helped but unfortunately, the next morning the odor had returned.  There were also some minor maintenance issues that needed to be addressed during my stay but were not a major inconvenience for me.  If the mildew/mold issue were resolved, I would definitely stay here again.  Ferdinand was apologetic and a very pleasant and responsive host.

First off, Velia gave us the warmest of welcomes. She then dove right into making sure we get the best experience and impression of Catania and it’s surrounding areas by meticulously showing us on a map and prepared lists the best sights, restaurants and cultural activities available. Now, the home, it’s just stunning. I think I haven’t come across an Airbnb that felt this much like a home. It’s spacious, very well equipped, tastefully “decorated”, has new appliances, an automated well working heating system (with proper radiator heaters), and what was a really pleasant surprise: very good mattresses and nice duvets and everything you need for a little child (including toys!). So yea, best place you can choose when in Catania. Thanks again Velia!
Amazing place. The location was amazing near cafés and bard. The room was clean and full of light. Communication with Agathe was easy and she was very nice providing instructions. :)

Amazing apartment on Bedford Avenue, main street of Brooklyn. Just three stops away from Union Square. Within steps of all kinds of great restaurants and coffee shops on every corner. Our favorites were Joe's Pizza across from Fabian's coffee shop, brunch at Sweet Chick and Rosamunde's Sausage Grill.  Katie is helpful and we got all help we needed.  If you are traveling to JFK airport try booking UBER since other taxis cost about $42.  Hope you enjoy staying there, we would definitely go back ! :)

Great location on the north side of the island.  The views were spectacular! So spectacular that other vacationers staying in the condo complex would gather outside of the unit to watch the sunrise, sunset and views. Normally wouldn’t be an issue, but this did impede on our privacy because the unit is a corner unit and on the ground level- people inevitably always looked into our place as they passed by.  There is no A/C in the unit and we wish there had been for sleeping. The private beach is a short distance, however, it’s a difficult walk. It’s a very steep walk with switchbacks and would not be easy for some people-so it’s not convenient. The private beach isn’t a great swimming beach- great for surfing though!  The screen doors and window screens had gaps and holes which allowed for bugs and geckos to infiltrate the condo. We we really impressed with the condo when we first arrived, but the impression wanted as time went on.  We didn’t find the only bed being a full/queen was adequate or comfortable enough for the pricey stay. We just did not feel that the place was worth the hefty price.  Wade was extremely responsive and we greatly appreciated that.   If the price matched th

An amazing stay.  The apartment was very  clean, cosy, comfortable and conveniently located in Noordhoek. It's a perfect getaway from the busy city and situated in a beautiful suburb with stunning views. The hosts are friendly and communicated quickly. Check in was seamless and the apartment had everything we needed for a short stay

Cute, comfortable and very clean. The house is close enough to Scarborough Beach that you can jog there, or a short drive with your beach chairs. It has luxurious bedding, and a very well equipped kitchen, with high quality pots, dishes, glassware, etc. None of those scratched and peeling Teflon pans you find in too many rentals! We enjoyed sitting in the sun room in the back of the house. The yard is nicely landscaped with mature trees and the back yard feels like a private oasis.

Apartment is built inside castle walls. Lovely, quiet location. About 10-12 min walk down steep hills to the centre of town so you do have to be prepared for walking. There is the option of a bus right up to the castle though if you don’t want to walk. Nice cafes nearby and a very nice local restaurant down the street.  The apartment itself is huge and is so clean and tidy. Three bedrooms with loads of space and three bathrooms. Beds are very comfortable and nice strong hot showers.  Large very well stocked kitchen. Streaming services on the three TVs. The communication with the staff was excellent. Very helpful and quick to reply to any questions. Carla should be a tour guide. She has so much information on where is good to visit in Lisbon. Lovely person!

It's a wonderful accommodation that you can enjoy your morning exercises and your brunch leisurely.What is more,hostess Michelle is very hospital,patient and warmhearted,she spoke slowly in order to let me understand easily and taught me lots of new words.I appreciate that so much.Highly recommended.It's a good choice for my return to US.

We had a very pleasant stay at Adam's place. Adam is a great host, the rooms were all very nice, tidy and spacious. Location is great as well as it's very close to the tube. I would definitely recommend this !

I met Savie, she was super nice, sweet and  very interested in helping. David was always present answering my messages super fast and explaining everything about the house or city. I really enjoyed my stay there, quiet, very clean and a beautiful home. I would definitely come back! ⭐⭐⭐
Pietro and Nadia were amazing hosts and really made sure we felt welcome on the beautiful island of Ustica!
Adorei a experiencia, ambiente limpo e cheiroso Além do anfitrião estar sempre disposto a nos auxiliar no que for preciso, responde super rápido Apesar de ser menor do que o esperado, super recomendo

Very nice and quite location located in heart of the city. Nearby to a lot of good restaurants and Downtown area. Very satisfied with the overall experience staying here. I would like to stay here in the future if I get the opportunity.

Loved staying in this Air Bnb and would definitely come back and stay again! There was an ant problem in the bathroom that the host was made aware of and had an exterminator come to evaluate the situation. I really appreciated how quickly the host responded and how they were responsive to the problem. Highly recommend staying here!
Great location, easy to walk everywhere or take train. Small, but that is expected in Tokyo. We had a very nice stay!
Great find. Cozy cottage within walking distance to many restaurants and beach. Molly was very easy to get in contact with. Just a bit loud by the road.
Clean Comfortable Quiet Airbnb.  Located close to bus and the L, good restaurants, church and Second City Comedy Club. Steep stairs to Airbnb, lovely neighborhood.
Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt. Perfekte Lage mit netten Restaurants in unmittelbarer Nähe, Wohnung war super sauber. Kommunikation und check in unkompliziert. Wir würden wieder kommen.

A SMAII LEND OF HEVEN!!!  VERY PEACEFUL AND QUIET.THE HOUSE WHIS THE SWIMMING POLE ARE VERY COMFORTABIE AND VERY BEAUTIFUL.THE HOSTS ARE VERY NICE AND VERY HELPFUL WHISE ALL THE NEEDS.ME,MAY WIFE AND OUR TREE DOTERS ENJOY THE STAYING VERY MUCH.                           A PLACE TO COMEBACK AGAIN. THANK YOU VERY MUCH BET

The pictures simply don’t do this place justice. Beautiful apartment with an enormous penthouse balcony and fabulous kitchen space - perfect place for morning coffees and quiet drinks at sundown. Joy was incredibly helpful and a quick communicator. Transport links are great, close to both tram and metro stations to get into central and out to the airport. I have no doubt we will be back again, thanks Joy for a wonderful stay.

Santorini is full of narrow steps everywhere. Villa Matilde is no exception to access. But, it's smack in THE location of Oia in Santorini, for THE photo shot of the blue dome churches, plus facing the Caldera. From the second level open deck, you will see couples having their wedding shoots and everyone jostling for the spot for THE photo, where you have the luxury of sipping wine and chilling in the deck chairs under the shade of the umbrella, taking your time to take the shot. Air con is very cold, which is much needed in this period of summer.  Two bedrooms, 3 toilets. Kitchen is stocked with pre packed breakfast. Cooking utensils, washing machine, body gel, shampoos, towels, are all provided. Already have friends asking me where I booked and wants it for their trip
Great spacious house for large families who want to spend time together. Ensuites in every room was a bonus. Pool & spa was fantastic & the coffee machine was a treat. Great location

We had a fantastic stay at Susana’s apartment. She was an absolutely lovely host who was easy to get in touch with and very kind and helpful. The apartment was lovely and bright, perfect location for us and had everything we needed. We walked everywhere our whole trip around Lisbon. Would definitely recommend Susana’s place to stay for a visit to Lisbon!

The apartment was in a beautiful location and as lovely as described. It was just two of us but the second bedroom was great to use for our luggage. Maria provided all the information we needed to have and she was a pleasant person to communicate with. We had a wonderful stay in Maria's apartment. Thank you Maria!

Turning into Leabank Square, this development is in process of gentrifying..   There are a mix of tenants and credit Leonora for coming in early and investing and upgrading her space with an awesome view of the canal, joggers, the new school across the canal, short minutes walk to bars/restaurants and my reason for staying, to see American baseball at London stadium (15 min walk tops)... The space is well appointed, fresh paint, flat is clean (as were beds, sheets, kitchen and living spaces), the dual washer/dryer worked beyond my dreams (it actually dried the clothes after washing them) and the space felt safe passing friendly neighbors in hall ways and those hanging out at tables bordering the canal..  Parking was a bit of a struggle because the numbers have worn off, but I found a spot outside and left my rental there for my 2 night stay without issue.. I would stay here again if came back to London Stadium....and Leonora provided excellent communication.

This accommodation is truly excellent. There is plenty of space and an excellent sitting space, perfect for a business traveller who is not out every evening.  Meral is an excellent host and I love the extra touches such as tourist leaflets, guest help pack etc. Nothing is too much trouble for Meral.  The space is private with its own front door and you would have no idea it is attached to the house.  I will be staying here again, and again, and again!!

Momo was very communicative and helpful! The place can be small for some but definitely more spacious and comfortable than most places you will find by more than double. Clean, has everything you need, and accessible. A good choice for your next stay!
This home was beautiful, clean, and in a fantastic location! Near the waterfront and many tourist attractions, the home was perfect for a quick weekend trip. Would stay here again.

James was a wonderful host.  He was very responsive to questions, sometimes answering way after-hours Paris time.  He provided helpful advice about the property, local shops and restaurants, transportation, and sights in Paris.  He has a prepared welcome/orientation packet for guests.   The space is very comfortable, spacious enough for our family of 6 (4 adults, 2 kids).  The building itself is older and showing its age a bit.  But the remodel of the apartment holds up nicely.  The neighbors and residents of the building were friendly and helpful.  There is a small elevator which can squeeze in 3 people (apartment is on 3rd floor - ground floor = 0).  Kitchen is small with small fridge, 3 burner electric stove.  There is electric kettle, toaster, microwave oven, coffee press, utensils, dishwasher.  We cooked 2 meals in.   Neighborhood is safe.  Property is just around corner from busy street (and Metro station).  There is a little bit of traffic noise at times, nothing disruptive.  Grocery shopping is very convenient with few markets all within walking distance.  There are a few restaurants and cafes and several bakeries also within short walking distance.   Norte Dame is about 20

We had a great time at Nathalie’s place. The house is gorgeous. The location was great for us as it’s near the Asian food area. Nathalie prepared us with great croissants on our first morning which we absolute love! Had a great time chatting to her about intellectual stuff. I would come back again.
Great stay in Galway, house in a perfect location close to city and Salthill. Quiet residential area. Four bedrooms made it ideal for all our family - clean, warm and comfortable.

Evan’s place provided a great stay for us while adventuring around San Diego County. Modern design elements, full kitchen and ample space for 5 people. Dedicated parking spot and multiple entrances were a nice touch. Located near the airport made it easy to head back home as well. Would stay here again!

Amazing stay! Zardaman's Brooklyn Airbnb exceeded all expectations. The apartment was spotless, cozy, and beautifully decorated, creating a perfect home-away-from-home atmosphere. The location was fantastic, with easy access to public transportation, great restaurants, and local attractions. Zardaman was an excellent host, providing clear instructions and prompt communication throughout our stay. The amenities provided were top-notch, including a well-equipped kitchen and comfortable bedding. I highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Brooklyn. We can't wait to return and stay here again! Would definitely try to stay longer if we had a chance.

loved this place. VERY CLEAN. Ernesto and his mom were very attentive and helpful. The only thing is the walls are thin so we could hear the neighbors buzzing alarm 😅....in the middle of the night....
it was the really good place and not so loud..And Rèka was to so friendly with me and helping me if i needed something..!!thank u for i can staying there☺️
